description: Readout-only pull as a DOSE-RESPONSE curve (v2). One unclamped Adam run on lm_head: loss = (1-cos(J_S_p, J_tgt_p)) per input_ids-paired sample + 0.1·KL(p_ed‖p_orig). Every 10 steps: dose ‖ΔW‖_F (α = ‖ΔW‖/‖W‖), bridge (fresh J_norm via h-reuse), true KL over the full vocab. Baseline at ΔW=0 included. α* = largest step where the per-window bridge gain ≥ knee_tol (None if no knee). v1 (alpha sweep as trust-region caps) was VOID: caps ≥0.1 never bind, α was not a dose, and its 'α*=0.01' was a first-slope artifact. v2 fixes the dose definition. Target pair is the last-layer pair (asserted).
